name: Narrow access bay between LOROS and Subway
observations: Native154 shows a narrow white-sign/dark doorway bay at the change between older charity row and Subway.
Door/opening is narrower than neighbouring display windows.

Do not expand it into a full-width public street or infer ownership of the upstairs rooms.
